rationale: The workflow already implements the applicable optimizations, and the remaining candidates are either contraindicated or lack required preconditions. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (cancel superseded runs) is already present via styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1 in every job, partitioning by workflow/branch-PR. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency caching) is already present via Swatinem/rust-cache@v2 in check/lints/test-plan/msrv and actions/cache@v4 in test-docker. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is not applied because the matrix jobs (test-plan/test-docker/msrv across ubuntu/windows/macos) represent required cross-OS coverage, matching the contraindication that every matrix outcome is required; switching fail-fast to true would weaken intended test coverage. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is not applied because the repository CI history shows no completed runs / not a measured baseline, so the precondition of representative successful-duration history is unmet and an arbitrary timeout risks breaking valid slow runs (e.g., flake/MSRV). Path filtering (paths-ignore docs/**) is already present. No new privileged actions, secrets, publishing/deployment, or network access would be added.
